maria (Perf): quick q — I ran an nsys + perfetto trace while reproing a kernel regression. It contains model identifiers and some KV cache keys. Where's the approved place to upload so runtime folks can analyze?

sam (eng-runtime): s3 is fine, but under the perf bucket only: s3://redwood-traces/eng-runtime/2025-06/ . Please redact customer IDs first.

cheng (SRE): also make sure the object ACLs are private and add a short README in the same folder with what command produced the trace + approximate time window.

maria (Perf): good call. Any recommended redaction steps? I'm worried about leaking model names and small customer IDs embedded in nvtx labels.

sam (eng-runtime): easiest: run the provided redact script (scripts/redact_trace.py) — it replaces common patterns and strips env labels. Example: `python tools/redact_trace.py --in raw_trace.nsys-rep --out raw_trace.redacted.nsys-rep`

sam (eng-runtime): if you don't have the script, a quick sed pass can help (not perfect):
```
# remove lines with customer_id or api_key
sed -E '/customer_id|api_key|user_id/d' raw_trace.txt > trace_partial_redacted.txt
# replace long model names
sed -E 's/model-[A-Za-z0-9_\-]+/model-REDACTED/g' trace_partial_redacted.txt > trace.redacted.txt
```

cheng (SRE): note: for perfetto traces export the timeline to JSON first if you plan to strip labels: `perfetto --txt -o trace.json` (or use perfetto UI to save as text) — then scrub JSON fields. For nsys, use `nsys export -t trace.nsys-rep --output trace.json` to get readable labels.

sam (eng-runtime): naming convention we use: `<team>-<YYYYMMDD>-<shortdesc>-<sha8>.<ext>` e.g. `eng-runtime-20250618-kernel-hotspot-1a2b3c4d.nsys-rep`. Put a small metadata file next to it: `eng-runtime-20250618-kernel-hotspot-1a2b3c4d.meta.txt` with the command line and kernel version.

maria (Perf): what about very large traces (10s of GB)? We can't keep those in the bucket forever. Who trims them?

cheng (SRE): large raw traces should go to the `incoming/large/` prefix and we keep them 7 days by default. If you need longer retention, request via `/trace-retain` (ops team approval). Otherwise run `nsys profile` with `--sample=kernel` or reduce tracing scope to specific PIDs to shrink size.

ops-bot: To get a presigned upload URL for the perf bucket run: `/trace-upload-request <s3-path> --expires 72h --reason "perf analysis"`. Ops will reply with a signed URL. Do NOT paste presigned URLs in public channels.

maria (Perf): perfect — I'll redact the model ids, drop the large raw in incoming/large, and request a presigned URL. Thanks :thumbsup:

sam (eng-runtime): when you post the link, include the meta file and the exact nsys/perfetto command and the approximate event time. That helps correlate traces with logs.

maria (Perf): will do. One more Q: should we also attach a perf timeline screenshot?

sam (eng-runtime): yes, small PNGs are useful for quick triage. Put `<samebase>.png` next to the trace.

maria (Perf): done — uploading now. I'll tag you both after the presigned URL is ready. :rocket:
